notes:
# Waymark 0.5.3

- Farming session summaries start with the next accepted soul pickup. Show observed souls, connected farming time, souls/hour after one minute, per-pet gains and confirmed rank-ups. Pause/resume or start a new session. Each character keeps a local summary across restarts; disconnected time and other characters are excluded.
- Add up to 12 pet goals using the target button on pet cards. Goals are shared by server, survive restarts and are included in private workspace saves. Completed and estimated-max states remain distinct.
- Smart next-target guidance prefers unfinished goals and nearby mapped pockets. Once a target reaches maximum progress, it advances to another eligible pet. Choose Another to change the suggestion, or turn guidance off.
- The minimap highlights visible targets and places an approximate direction arrow at its edge for offscreen targets. Cross-map suggestions say Travel to Verteron/Altgard/Abyss. Stale or unavailable position readings suppress direction and distance. Guidance is straight-line reference guidance, not terrain-aware navigation or live monster detection.
- Farming summaries are local and included in full backups. Older backups remain readable. Existing low-priority reader scheduling, compact minimap payloads and cached marker calculations are retained; session summaries reuse the existing pet polling response.
